title: Cancellation or withdrawal
intro: Cancellation is separate from consent withdrawal. Simulated payments only.
subject: Order reference
organization: Business reference (leave empty for personal orders)
unavailable: The outcome is unavailable. Keep this request reference and resolve it before trying another action.
denied: Access or request denied. Reload current permission and order details.
consequences: Unpaid orders release only when payment attempts are conclusively resolved. Paid orders pause for price or refundable job amount review. Collected fees are never refunded. A custody transfer needs a controlled return or recorded failure exception. A refund decision is not refunded money.
held: Funds or custody remain under review; cancellation is not complete.
none: Enter the current order details to request cancellation.
scope: Review uses current record and business permission.
invalid: Enter valid references, a positive revision and a reason.
source_review: Payment, work or custody facts need review.
return_pending: Correct watch and accessories return is pending.
decision_required: An authorized cancellation decision is pending.
refund_review: Price or job amount refund review is required.
stale_revision: The order changed. Reload its current revision.
request_required: A pending cancellation request is required.
unknown: Current details are unavailable. Resolve the same reference.
